name: Fireflies
desc: Wandering bioluminescent points whose blinks gradually synchronize over minutes (Kuramoto coupling) then scatter at each section change.

style.doc: biolum=green-gold soft glow / lantern=large warm amber / spark=crisp blue-white electric / constellation=abstracted network web linking synced neighbors

act.doc: swarm=strong sync / scatter=chaotic no-sync / pulse=coupling breathes in and out
